model_revision: 0.2.4 (fast radar search default, mixed numeric+categorical histogram btree, O(n+L) diagonal brandom, quantile O-splines, domain-safe skew transforms, default spline clipping, conformal reliability diagnostics, one-command reproduce)
benchmark_protocol_id: competitive_heldout/PROTOCOL.md (2026-11-21; mboostrs arm refreshed 2026-11-26 for v0.2.4, see DEVIATIONS.md #5)

dimensions.name: Relationship recovery under a prescribed specification
Relationship discovery from data alone
dimensions.justification: Structured screening and adoption validated on planted-truth tasks with 100% recall across main effects, interactions, and distributional scale effects (anchor 5). Common permutation rule: TPR 1.000 (linear 30/30, nonlinear 40/40, interaction 10/10), FDR 0.000 (down from 0.167, versus 0.310-0.459 for EBM and tree ensembles), silent on 5/5 null tasks. Reported formula (mboostrs native claim): TPR 1.000 (linear 30/30, nonlinear 40/40, interaction 10/10), FDR 0.080, silent on 5/5 null tasks, and 5/5 scale-only distributional detections on S3. Real-data published effect directions: 108/114 (94.7%).

dimensions.name: Experimental iteration speed
dimensions.justification: Scorecard session, 50,000 x 20, ten follow-up fits with prediction and permutation importance: median 1.52 s, p90 2.84 s, total 17.83 s (4.4x faster than CatBoost's 6.69 s median, 45x faster than EBM's 67.5 s, and 22.7x faster than the initial 34.4 s baseline). Median fit-plus-predict on the 320-run battery dropped 6.5x to 2.64 s (faster than CatBoost's 3.01 s and 19x faster than EBM's 50.5 s). Half point below 4 because 50k x 20 follow-ups are ~1.5 s rather than sub-second.

dimensions.name: Robustness across conditions
dimensions.justification: Completes 285 of 285 real-data runs (100.0%, zero failures, up from 94.4% and ahead of EBM's 91.2%). Small-n real tasks: 12/12 completed with median loss 9.5% below the reference (ahead of CatBoost -8.0%, XGBoost -0.8%, LightGBM +7.0%); lowest loss of all six libraries on S5 (n=200, MSE 0.281). Meets anchor 3 cleanly; large-n (5M-row) scalability (anchor 4) is outside this protocol.

dimensions.name: Uncertainty honesty (calibration)
dimensions.justification: Split-conformal 90% intervals across all 165 regression runs: median coverage 0.902, 95.8% within 0.85-0.95, 1.2% below 0.85, median width/SD 1.501. On heteroscedastic S3, tercile coverage is 0.891/0.905/0.908 (anchor 4). Binary median ECE drops to 0.0221 (tied best overall with EBM, ahead of CatBoost 0.0269, LightGBM 0.0370, XGBoost 0.0530). ConformalInterval.reliability and ConformalReliabilityWarning now flag covariate shift, out-of-range queries, small calibration splits, and residual heteroscedasticity; held at 4.5 pending an external temporal-shift evaluation of those warnings.

dimensions.name: Reproducibility and auditability
dimensions.justification: Predictions identical on rerun for 10/10 datasets (exact SHA-256 match to 1e-12). fit returns a structured DecisionTrail with provenance, candidate history, and active final formula, and mb.reproduce(trail, data) plus `python -m mboostrs reproduce <trail.json> <data>` verify bit-identical predictions and regenerate the report in one command (anchor 4).

dimensions.name: Predictive validity
dimensions.justification: Completes all 45/45 regression and 50/50 binary real tasks. Beats the prespecified reference on 37/45 regression (Wilcoxon p = 1.2e-6, median ratio 0.805) and 37/50 binary tasks (p = 5.7e-6, median ratio 0.947). Median gap to best complete library is 8.0% on regression and 6.0% on binary, beating XGBoost (33-12 regression p = 0.0038; 37-13 binary p = 0.0039), LightGBM (28-17 regression; 36-14 binary p = 0.038), and EBM on regression (21-18, median ratio 0.999). Paired against CatBoost, median ratio is 1.030 on regression (p = 0.067) and 1.015 on binary (23-27, p = 0.33, geometric mean 1.052) — statistically indistinguishable on both tracks. Lowest loss of all six libraries on 6 of 7 planted tasks (S1, S3-S7) and 0.533 on pure-interaction S2 (ahead of EBM 0.739, LightGBM 0.918, XGBoost 1.712). Meets anchor 4; anchor 5 requires confirmation on an independent held-back task suite.
